items.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
items.descriptionZh: 让你的编码 Agent 紧跟最新 Web 最佳实践

items.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
items.descriptionZh: 使用 Univer Office SDK 构建你自己的 AI 办公套件。为人和 AI Agent 带来编辑、计算、协作与文件处理能力，基于可扩展的开源内核。

items.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
items.descriptionZh: 用于跟进并掌控 Agent 的工作空间——塑造、决策、规划、标注、审查代码、与团队共享，一键将所有反馈发送给 Agent。
面向编码 Agent 的 Chrome DevTools

items.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
items.descriptionZh: 面向股票投资者和交易者的 Claude Code 技能——市场分析、技术图表、经济日历、筛选器和交易策略开发。

items.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
items.descriptionZh: 安全、快速、高效，经阿里巴巴规模实战检验。混合架构代码审查工具：确定性流水线 + LLM Agent，精确行级评论，内置多语言规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入），兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。

items.description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
items.descriptionZh: 面向编码 Agent 交付的自托管工作流。用脚本和人工审批关卡编排 CodeBuddy、Codex 与 Claude Code，含编码助手的本地工作流。

items.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
items.descriptionZh: AG-UI：Agent 与用户交互协议，将 Agent 引入前端应用。

items.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
items.descriptionZh: 一套为 Stitch MCP 服务器设计的 Agent Skills 库。每个 skill 遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，兼容 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等编码 Agent。

items.description: Multi-tier framework for evaluating AI agent skills with quality gates, semantic overlap detection, synthetic evaluation dataset generation, and live agent evaluation that measures how skills affect agent behavior.
items.descriptionZh: 多层级框架，用于评估 AI Agent 技能，包含质量门禁、语义重叠检测、合成评估数据集生成，以及衡量技能如何影响 Agent 行为的实时 Agent 评估。

items.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
items.descriptionZh: 面向漏洞挖掘与外部红队工作的 Claude Code 技能包：82 个技能、15 个斜杠命令、覆盖 24 个核心漏洞类别的 681 个已披露报告模式，以及企业身份与基础设施攻击矩阵。
用于机器学习的张量库
